verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted scraping/URL-to-Markdown API, so a prebuilt connector for no-code platforms like n8n or Zapier is a fair question. The evidence covers only raw HTTP endpoints, headers, a container image and an MCP server, and never mentions an n8n node, a Zapier app or any other no-code connector. The MCP server is an agent integration, not a no-code automation connector, and probes found no OpenAPI spec that could be imported into such platforms.
